title: Muruku
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

        rice flour 3 cups

        urad dal

        dalia 1/4 cup

        butter 3 tablespoon 

        milk 2 cups

        sesame seeds

        salt

        How to prepare:

        First fry urad dal and keep it aside next fry 1/4 cup dalia and keep it aside . In a mixi jar add 
        them and make it sommth powder. In another bowl add 3 cups of rice flour, grunded urad flour,dalia butter,and sesame seeds 
        and add some milk and mix them well mix the dough well in chapathi consistency. In a deep frying pan 
        fry the murukus golden brown, and enjoy it with a cup of tea.
